rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: PageGuard is an MCP server for privacy compliance scanning, built for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It detects tracking technologies, misconfigured cookies, consent gaps, and other data privacy issues across a website and generates compliance documentation. An optional API key unlocks URL scanning and document generation features; local scans run without an account.
